prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” interior painter for all situations — the right one depends on your neighborhood, budget, project size, timeline and any special needs (color consultation, trim/stain work, wall repairs, eco‑friendly paints, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. To start, tell me your zip code and a few details (number of rooms, square footage or type of room, rough budget, and when you want it done).

While you decide, here’s a quick, practical plan to find a top interior painting company in St. Louis and pick the best contractor for your job:

Where to search
- Google Maps and Google Reviews
- Yelp
- Angi (formerly Angie’s List) and HomeAdvisor
- Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- Nextdoor or local neighborhood Facebook groups for personal referrals

What to look for in reviews and profiles
- Consistently high ratings (4.0+ with many reviews)
- Recent reviews describing similar jobs (interior work, rooms like yours)
- Photos of finished projects
- Evidence of professionalism (clear communication, timely, cleanup)

Questions to ask every painter
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you show proof?
- Do you provide a written estimate? What’s included (prep, number of coats, materials)?
- What paint brands and sheen do you use?
- How do you handle prep (patching cracks, priming, sanding)?
- Do you provide color consultation or sample patches?
- How long will the job take and what’s your start date?
- Do you offer a warranty or touch‑up guarantee?
- Can you provide local references or recent examples?

Red flags
- Very low estimate compared to competitors without an explanation
- No written contract
- Pressure to pay full amount upfront
- Poor communication or lack of references

Typical cost ranges (St. Louis area — varies by scope)
- Per room (small/average): $300–$900
- Per square foot (walls only): $1.50–$4.50 / sq ft
- Larger jobs or special finishes will cost more

Sample message to send when requesting quotes
“Hi — I need interior painting for [rooms or sq ft] in [zip]. Could you provide a written estimate that includes prep work, number of coats, paint brands, timeline, start date, and warranty? Are you licensed and insured, and can you provide references or photos of similar projects?”

If you give me your zip code and a little more about your project (how many rooms, any repairs needed, budget), I’ll suggest a short list of likely top options and help you draft messages or a comparison checklist for estimates.
